generations.name: First generation
generations.notes: Battery-electric version only (the Clarity Plug-in Hybrid and Fuel Cell are not BEVs). 25.5 kWh pack, CCS1 DC fast charging, about 3.5 h on 240 V. Lease-only in California and Oregon; production stopped end of 2019. US only (no NRCan rows). EPA label prefix "Clarity EV" is used instead of base model "Clarity" so the PHEV/FCEV could never be caught. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Honda_Clarity
